as_told.title: Pasulka's Heaven Can Wait finds abduction-like accounts in Catholic sources

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Diana Pasulka, a religious studies professor at the University of North Carolina Wilmington, was researching a 2014 book on Purgatory called Heaven Can Wait when she began recording dozens of historical cases of nuns, priests, brothers and saints who reported direct contact with God or angels. In another episode he describes these accounts as resembling alien abductions and brings up Saint Francis of Assisi. He tells it because it would suggest modern UFO encounters echo much older religious experiences.
